metric_definitions.canonical: unchanged frozen assessment canonical_correct, including declared execution_ok
metric_definitions.denominators: planned 72/64/8 always retained; raw semantic additionally reports applicable rows (including missing failures) and actual model calls separately; format/protocol use actual model calls only
metric_definitions.executable_canonical_question_semantic: frozen canonical_correct AND reviewed business action true AND question_text_adequate is not false; v1 is legacy arithmetic replay, v2 is local dispatcher
metric_definitions.model_raw_semantic: same conjunction using frozen raw_action_fields_correct when invoked; only an actual program bypass is null/NA and never a model success; missing results are false and retained in paired comparisons
metric_definitions.paired: same backend/input v2 vs v1; group score requires both original group cases present and correct; singleton cohorts excluded, raw NA reported incomparable
metric_definitions.system_action_question_semantic: frozen system_action_fields_correct AND reviewed business action true AND question_text_adequate is not false; deterministic non-question rows need no review

review_status: independent blind Agent review, not human expert validation
scope: 72 Agent-authored synthetic snapshots in 36 paired groups; no training; no real-case or expert accuracy claim
